name: kubernetes_node_out_of_pod_capacity
title: Kubernetes Node out of pod capacity
description: Node is out of pod capacity

source.upstream_alert: Kubernetes Node out of pod capacity
source.upstream_query: sum by (node) ((kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1) + on(uid, instance) group_left(node) (0 * kube_pod_info{pod_template_hash=""})) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods"}) * 100 > 90
source.upstream_description: Node {{ $labels.node }} is out of pod capacity

query_condition.promql: sum by (node) ((kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1) + on(uid, instance) group_left(node) (0 * kube_pod_info{pod_template_hash=""})) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods"}) * 100
